expo.name: HomeCore
expo._comment_scheme: Must match the scheme passed to AuthSession.makeRedirectUri in lib/auth-context.tsx, and be registered under Supabase > Auth > URL Configuration as homecoreos://auth/callback.
expo._comment_favicon: No favicon key: Expo's web favicon pipeline rasterises the source and rejects SVG, and public/favicon.svg is all this repo has. Add a PNG and point `web.favicon` at it to restore the branded tab icon.
